summary_en: The caller, Ravi Kumar, initiated the call to purchase 200 matte visiting cards. The agent provided the pricing, stating that 100 cards cost ₹350, making the total for 200 cards ₹700. The caller then shared his name and delivery address in Vijayawada (12 MG Road). The agent summarized the details and confirmed the order, noting that delivery would take 3 working days in Vijayawada after artwork approval. The caller agreed to the confirmation, thanked the agent, and ended the call.
